Task complete and verified. Summary:

- Installed `mysql-server` (8.0.46) via apt; the postinst couldn't auto-start in the systemd-less container, so I initialized/ran `mysqld` directly as the `mysql` user.
- Added `/etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d/zz-benchmark.cnf` setting `port=3307`, and started the daemon (socket `/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock`, listening on 3307).
- Created `benchmark_user` (password `benchmark_pass`) for both `localhost` and `%` with `ALL PRIVILEGES ON benchmark_db.*`.
- Applied migrations in dependency order — `02_schema.sql.gz` (schema/DB/tables/view) **before** `01_seed.sql.gz` (data) despite the filename numbering — stripping the invalid `DEFINER=\`devops\`@\`%\`` clause so the view creates successfully.
- Verified over TCP `-h 127.0.0.1 -P 3307` as `benchmark_user`: `categories`=2 rows, `products`=2 rows, `category_view`=2 rows, view definer resolves to `root@localhost`.
